[EN] If you can defeat {@LinkCreature:32#7#Stalker Company reapers}, you can consider yourself a hero. They're tough as the permafrost.

If you want to prove yourself, you can find them in the mercenary camp in the basin to the north.
[ES] Si puedes derrotar a los {@LinkCreature:32#7#Stalker Company reapers}, puedes considerarte un héroe. Son duros como el permafrost.

Si quieres demostrar tu valía, puedes encontrarlos en el campamento mercenario en la cuenca al norte.

[EN] Ah! Just as I thought! You're a true hero. It will be an honor to fight at your side.
[ES] ¡Ah! ¡Tal como pensé! Eres un verdadero héroe. Será un honor luchar a tu lado.
